evidence: This track starts on the opposite side of the Matukituki River from Camerons Flat.
Ford the Matukituki River at Camerons Flat.
The track passes through beech forest to the top of the gorge and ends at Aspiring Flats.

doubts: The page never says how the walk is finished: the track ends at Aspiring Flats and the legs total 4 hr while DOC's time is 8–10 hr, which suggests a return the same way, but this is not stated, so shape is null and kind unclear. The start is the Camerons Flat ford (T5); the Camerons Flat car park could not be matched confidently to any road end feature (F1/F2 are on Cameron Flat Road, F3 on Wanaka-Mount Aspiring Road), and the MacPherson Creek alternative start is also left without a ref. The Rock of Ages Biv lies 30 min beyond where the track reaches the flats, off any marked track.
